scope: development only; 001D interpretation; no reranking, contract freeze or final test
resize: Pillow RGB thumbnail, LANCZOS, aspect preserved; never upscale; no additional crop
input_views: one full prepared garment photo per wardrobe garment; human-confirmed crop only per component; no full inspiration context
input_metadata: neutral request ID and inline PNG pixels only; no category, filename, reference attribute, relevance grade or retrieval score
resource_policy: development guard, not an approved final gate; stop candidate on timeout, RAM ceiling or low headroom; preserve partial results
scoring: exact vocabulary match; human unknown excluded from accuracy denominator; model unknown is abstention; invalid whole schema counts as unanswered and incorrect on every human-known field; no repairs, retries or tuning from scores
schema: exact JSON keys garment_type,color,pattern,description; enums from review vocabulary; description nonempty <=240 characters; duplicate keys fail
descriptions: owner checks all 28 when available, plus explicit retained occluded pair inspection; record unsupported details, including any unsupported material, brand, hidden regions, fit or construction
measurements: input preparation measured separately; wall perf_counter startup through /health ready; first generation in fresh server is process-cold (OS disk cache uncontrolled); immediate repeated first input is warm; cache_prompt=false; per-request wall time includes request serialization, HTTP, inference and response parsing, excludes prior PNG preparation; native server peak working set from Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo polled every 20ms and at shutdown; no GPU; Python orchestration memory excluded
prompt: Inspect only the visible garment in this image. If multiple garments cannot be separated, use unknown for ambiguous fields. Return ONLY one JSON object with exactly garment_type, color, pattern, description. garment_type choices: tshirt, shirt, sweater, sweatshirt, vest, jacket, coat, trousers, jeans, shorts, skirt, dress, other, unknown. tshirt includes polo; shirt includes blouse; sweater includes knitted cardigan; shorts includes denim shorts; trousers excludes denim. color choices: black, white, gray, beige, brown, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, multicolor, unknown. Use the main visible garment color, ignoring background and small trim. Navy/light blue -> blue; cream/tan -> beige; silver -> gray; burgundy -> red. Use multicolor if no color dominates more than about half the visible garment. pattern choices: solid, striped, checked, dotted, graphic, floral, other, unknown. solid means no visible repeated motif or prominent graphic; ignore texture, seams and small logos. checked includes plaid; graphic means prominent lettering/logo/illustration; floral includes leaves; other includes mixed patterns. Use unknown whenever visible detail is insufficient. description: one short factual sentence, at most 240 characters, only visible garment features. Never guess material, brand, fit or concealed details.
